beats: setting: Sunny Meadow Garden; event: Poppy finds a tiny basket of sweet clover blossom treats next to her favorite carrot patch.; temptation: Eat all the sweet clover blossoms quickly before anyone else notices them.; the right choice: Save half of the sweet blossoms to offer to her friend Pip the squirrel.

setting: The Shady Brookside; event: Poppy has a shiny, smooth skipping stone that bounces across the water higher than any other stone.; temptation: Keep the lucky stone tucked under her paw so she can have the best turn every time.; the right choice: Pass the smooth stone to Pip so he can try skipping it across the water too.

setting: Under the Big Oak Tree; event: A sudden summer rain shower begins, and Poppy has a wide, dry dock leaf held over her pink bow.; temptation: Huddle under the leaf alone to stay completely cozy and dry.; the right choice: Invite a shivering little bluebird to squeeze under the wide leaf beside her.

setting: The Berry Bush Maze; event: Poppy discovers a secret low branch packed with ripe, juicy blueberries.; temptation: Fill her cheeks with every single berry so nobody else can taste them.; the right choice: Call out to the other woodland critters to come pick the delicious berries together.

setting: The Daisy Hilltop Playground; event: Poppy brings a bright red bouncing ball that all the animals admire and want to play with.; temptation: Play keep-away and bounce the ball by herself so it does not get scuffed.; the right choice: Start a circle game where everyone tosses and catches the ball together.

setting: The Cozy Tree Hollow Art Nook; event: Poppy has a set of vibrant colorful flower-petal paints, but there is only one paintbrush.; temptation: Paint the entire tree trunk mural by herself without giving up the brush.; the right choice: Take turns painting and show Pip how to use finger paints using petal tips.

setting: The Windy Whispering Pines; event: Poppy carries a warm, knitted scarf on a chilly afternoon when her friend's paws grow cold.; temptation: Wrap the warm scarf twice around her own neck and keep walking.; the right choice: Drape the scarf across both of their shoulders as they walk side by side.

setting: Sunset Glade Picnic Table; event: Poppy receives a prize carrot cake at the meadow festival to celebrate the end of a joyful day.; temptation: Take the whole cake home to eat quietly in her burrow.; the right choice: Cut big slices for all her friends and celebrate the happy feast together.
